dedupe_keys.name: collecte des dechets electriques et electroniques a issy les moulineaux

description: Collecte des déchets électriques et électroniques à Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Ce jeu de données présente la quantité de déchets électriques et électroniques récoltés en tonnes, le nombre de collectes et le nombre de personnes ayant déposé des déchets entre 2015 et 2019. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are déchets, GPSO, dataviz1. The portal shows 5 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2020-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
